title: Split seven more linux_configuration scripts across mtk_root, utils, fixes and features
objective: Bring 10-recon.sh (349), install_exercism.sh (330), fix_arch_performance.sh (326), format_sd_card.sh (323), setup_dot_resolver.sh (309), fix_unity.sh (302) and 20-dump-stock.sh (295) under the 250-line cap.
acceptance_criteria: All seven entry scripts and all eight new libs are at most 250 lines.
bash -n and shellcheck pass on every touched file, with no new suppression and no shellcheck disable directive.
The stubbed run reports every moved function as defined, for all seven scripts.
When a script is split twice, the second split must not remove the first split's source line: every lib a script's functions live in is sourced by the entry script, and no lib sources another.
No script is executed. These read partitions over USB, format SD cards, install certificates and register MIME handlers.
The desktop_dir global read across the fix_unity split is resolved by matching the file's naming convention for globals, not by a suppression.
out_of_scope: Executing any recon, dump, format or install step. The mtk_root scripts in particular talk to a phone over USB.
The remaining no-main scripts (setup_passwordless_system.sh, nvidia_troubleshoot.sh, main.sh and the test harnesses), which need the by-hand treatment.
Changing what any script does when run.
verifier: scratchpad/verify_split.sh per script (bash -n + shellcheck -x + stubbed run), plus check_file_length.sh showing none of the fifteen files, plus pre-commit run --files and the real git commit for jscpd.
